candidate_output.R1_R4: frozen fundamental core multiplied by one global market multiplier
candidate_output.R5_R6: market-translated R4 tier values followed by the single frozen market-tail decay

forbidden: change the frozen Phase 0 fundamental R1-R4 estimator
fit separate market multipliers by round or tier
use KTC to refit player-outcome Fundamental Value
use noisy historical R4->R5 or R5->R6 expected-player ratios as direct market prices

historical_tail_diagnostic.purpose: Recompute R3->R4, R4->R5, and R5->R6 expected-player transition behavior and preserve it as a diagnostic proving why direct late-round outcome ratios are not used as market-tail prices.
historical_tail_diagnostic.source: exact V8 2018-2023 H3 O2 development corpus

market_tail.formula: d_market = geometric mean over early/mid/late of KTC combined R4/R3 ratios; R5_tier = market_R4_tier*d_market; R6_tier = R5_tier*d_market
market_tail.interpretation: Rounds 5-6 are explicitly market-tail extrapolation, not KTC-observed cells and not independently fitted fundamental cells.
market_tail.reason: Phase 0 showed historical R4->R5 and R5->R6 expected-player outcomes are sparse/noisy and do not form a stable declining market curve. KTC itself stops at Round 4.

market_translation.formula: m = exp(mean_cell(log(KTC_2027_combined_cell / frozen_core_FV_cell))); market_cell = frozen_core_FV_cell * m
market_translation.purpose: Translate frozen ex-ante Fundamental Value into the market-equivalent accounting scale used for tradable draft-pick values without changing relative fundamental shape.
market_translation.tradesourced_and_crowdsourced_role: external disagreement band and robustness diagnostics only; central fit uses combined series

next_stage_if_pass: V10 Phase 2 Production-Candidate Audit and Engineering Bridge
production_gates: all 18 candidate values are monotone nonincreasing in canonical R1-early through R6-late order
market bridge LOCO median absolute log error <= 0.08
market bridge LOCO maximum absolute log error <= 0.15
at least 75% of R1-R4 cells lie inside the tradesourced-to-crowdsourced band after the one-parameter bridge
market bridge central multiplier lies between trade-only and crowd-only global multipliers
market tail decay lies strictly between 0 and 1
market tail combined decay lies between trade-only and crowd-only R3->R4 aggregate decays

scientific_interpretation.evidence_status: This market bridge is exposed development calibration motivated by Phase 0. It is not a fresh confirmatory validation result.
scientific_interpretation.phase0_finding: Raw class-balanced expected-value FV had perfect rank agreement with KTC but a nearly uniform absolute scale gap across all 12 R1-R4 cells.
scientific_interpretation.response: Do not alter or refit the frozen fundamental estimator. Introduce a separately labeled market-translation layer with one global degree of freedom.
